title: A multilevel circuit gating framework for transforming sexual motivation into sexual action: Insights from mouse models
title_zh: 多层电路阈值框架：从性 motivation 到性行为的转化：鼠模型的见解
abstract: Sexual behaviour consists of a appetitive phase and a consummatory phase. Based primarily on research evidence from rodents (particularly male mice), this paper presents a multi-level gate model that explains how the transition between these two phases occurs. In this model, the processing of cues associated with a potential mate is initiated in the main olfactory bulb (MOB) and the accessory olfactory bulb (AOB) systems. These cues are then transmitted through limbic circuits, such as the medial amygdala (MeA) and the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BNST), where they are encoded as valuable mating information. Subsequently, these cues are integrated with internal motivational states, including social cues, hormonal status, Sexual reward experience, and sexual satiety, within cell-type-specific circuits centred on the preoptic area (POA). This integration process results in the generation of a motivational gain. When intrinsic motivational states are integrated with somatosensory inputs related to the partner, a state-dependent sensory contact gating mechanism facilitates the transition from exploratory contact to mating behaviours (e.g. mounting). In the downstream process, theperiaqueductal gray (PAG), brainstem, spinal cord, and mesolimbic reward circuits coordinate the sequence of intromission and ejaculation behaviours. During the process of mating, feedback mechanisms such as reward reinforcement and sexual reward modulate future motivational states and action thresholds. Finally, we discuss sex differences in the neural mechanisms underlying the transition from appetitive to consummatory. This conceptual model provides a testable hypothesis regarding the neural mechanisms underlying sexual dysfunction caused by insufficient sexual motivation or disrupted action gating thresholds.
abstract_zh: 性行为主要由欲望阶段和射精阶段组成。基于啮齿类动物（特别是雄性小鼠）的研究证据，本文提出了一个多层阈值模型，阐述了这两个阶段之间转化的过程。在该模型中，与潜在配偶相关的线索处理主要在主嗅球（MOB）和嗅球（AOB）系统中启动。随后，这些线索通过杏仁核（MeA）和尾状核（BNST）等边缘系统传递，在那里被编码为有价值的交配信息。随后，这些线索与内在动机状态——包括社交线索、激素状态、性奖赏经验和性饱和感——在前额下区（POA）为中心的细胞特异性电路中整合。这种整合过程产生了动机增益。当内在动机状态与伴侣相关的体感输入整合时，状态依赖的体感接触阈值机制促进了从探索性接触向交配行为（如跨坐）的转化。在下游过程中，周围灰质（PAG）、脑干、脊髓和中脑边缘奖赏电路协调交配行为的交接和射精序列。在交配过程中，奖赏强化和性奖赏等反馈机制会调节未来的动机状态和行动阈值。最后，我们讨论了性别差异在从欲望向射精神经机制中的作用。该概念模型为性欲不足或阈值中断导致的性功能障碍的神经机制提供了可检验的假设。
